 if(s.win||s.loss||s.funds.length>=8)throw Error('Keine weitere Fondsgeneration möglich.');
 if(!FUND_STYLES.includes(strategy)||!Number.isFinite(target)||target<2e6||target>1e8||!Number.isInteger(years)||years<5||years>12||!Number.isFinite(management)||management<.005||management>.025||!Number.isFinite(carry)||carry<0||carry>.25)throw Error('Ungültige Fondsparameter');
 if(s.funds.length&&(s.funds.some(f=>f.fundraise&&!f.finalClose)||s.month-s.funds.at(-1).launchMonth<12))throw Error('Fundraising abschließen und mindestens zwölf Monate warten.');
 const id='own'+(s.funds.length+1),f={id,name:String(name||'Matu Capital '+strategy+' '+['I','II','III','IV','V','VI','VII','VIII'][s.funds.length]).slice(0,72),strategy,vintage:2027+Math.floor(s.month/12),target,years,launchMonth:s.month,age:0,management,carry,status:'fundraising',fundraise:true,firstClose:false,finalClose:false,clients:[],commitmentTotal:0,paidTotal:0,cash:0,units:0,holdings:[],feeDue:0,feesReceived:0,carryReceived:0,distributions:0,realized:0,realizedProfit:0,returnedBudget:0,trust:75,missed:0,history:[],recentReturn:0};
 s.funds.push(f);s.selected=id;post(s,'Fonds gegründet!',`${f.name} startet mit ${years} Jahren Laufzeit. Das Fundraising-Buffet ist eröffnet.`,'v9_fof','🏛 Neue Generation',true);return f;
};
const availableTalks=s=>Math.max(0,SALES_CAP[s.sales]-s.usedTalks),availableReviews=s=>Math.max(0,RESEARCH_CAP[s.research]-s.usedReviews);
const prospect=s=>{const f=chosenFund(s);if(!f||!f.fundraise)return null;const eligible=INVESTORS.filter(p=>!f.clients.some(c=>c.prospect===p.id)&&s.seen[p.id+'|'+f.id]!==s.month);return eligible[Math.floor(rand(s)*eligible.length)]||null};
const pitch=(s,id,answer)=>{
 const f=chosenFund(s),p=INVESTORS.find(p=>p.id===id);if(!f?.fundraise||!p)throw Error('Kein aktives LP-Fundraising.');if(!availableTalks(s)||s.seen[id+'|'+f.id]===s.month||f.clients.some(c=>c.prospect===id))throw Error('Gespräch schon verwendet.');
 const chosen=options(p)[answer];if(!chosen)throw Error('Antwort ungültig.');s.usedTalks++;s.seen[id+'|'+f.id]=s.month;
 const bonus=chosen.key===p.style?.29:chosen.key==='daten'?.12:chosen.key==='hype'?.13:-.08;
 const previous=s.funds.filter(x=>x!==f),track=previous.length?clamp(previous.reduce((a,x)=>a+(x.paidTotal?(x.distributions+nav(x))/x.paidTotal-1:0),0)/previous.length,-.2,.28):0;
 const chance=clamp(.38+bonus+(s.reputation-12)*.008+(overallTrust(s)-75)*.003+track*.26-(f.management-.015)*9-(f.carry-.15)*.17,.06,.92);
 const won=rand(s)<chance;let value=0;if(won){value=round(Math.min(f.target-f.commitmentTotal,p.base*(.7+rand(s)*.7)*(1+.25*(s.funds.length-1))));if(value>1000){f.clients.push({prospect:id,name:p.name,kind:p.kind,commitment:value,open:value,paid:0,dist:0,trust:clamp(75+bonus*16-(chosen.key==='hype'?12:0),25,95),promised:chosen.key==='hype'});f.commitmentTotal=round(f.commitmentTotal+value);s.reputation=clamp(s.reputation+(chosen.key==='hype'?-.5:1),0,100);f.trust=trust(f);if(!f.firstClose&&f.commitmentTotal>=Math.min(1200000,f.target*.24)){f.firstClose=true;post(s,'First Closing!',`${currency(f.commitmentTotal)} zugesagt. Mort hat den Champagner schon als Betriebsausgabe gebucht.`,'v9_final','🥂 First Closing',true)}post(s,'LP sagt JA!',`${p.name} sagt ${currency(value)} zu. Ein Commitment ist noch keine Einzahlung.`,p.image,'🤝 Commitment');return{won:true,value};}}
 s.reputation=clamp(s.reputation-.25,0,100);post(s,'„Wir melden uns.“',`${p.name} meint damit angeblich „sehr zeitnah“. Mort glaubt nur noch an Cashflows.`,p.image,'🙃 Kein Commitment');return{won:false,value:0};
};
const finalClose=(s,f=chosenFund(s))=>{if(!f?.fundraise)throw Error('Fundraising geschlossen.');if(f.commitmentTotal<Math.min(1200000,f.target*.24))throw Error('Noch kein ausreichend großes First Closing.');f.fundraise=false;f.finalClose=true;f.status='investing';post(s,'Final Closing!',`${currency(f.commitmentTotal)} Commitments. Der CFO legt Excel vorsichtig zur Seite.`,'v9_final','✅ Final Closing',true);return f};
function callCapital(s,f,value){const amt=round(Math.min(lpOpen(f),Math.max(0,value)));if(amt<.01)return 0;const unit=f.units>0?Math.max(.01,nav(f)/f.units):1;let rem=amt;const base=lpOpen(f);for(const c of f.clients.filter(c=>c.open>.001)){const amount=round(Math.min(c.open,rem,amt*c.open/base));c.open=round(c.open-amount);c.paid=round(c.paid+amount);rem=round(rem-amount)}if(rem>.001){const last=f.clients.find(c=>c.open>=rem-.01);if(last){last.open=round(last.open-rem);last.paid=round(last.paid+rem);rem=0}}
 const paid=round(amt-rem);f.paidTotal=round(f.paidTotal+paid);f.cash=round(f.cash+paid);f.units=round(f.units+paid/unit);return paid}
const callLP=(s,portion=.25,f=chosenFund(s))=>{if(!f||!Number.isFinite(portion)||portion<=0||portion>1||lpOpen(f)<=0)throw Error('Kein zulässiger Kapitalabruf.');const paid=callCapital(s,f,lpOpen(f)*portion);post(s,'LP-Kapital eingezahlt',`${currency(paid)} wurden abgerufen – das ist ein Zufluss, keine Rendite.`,'v9_carry','💶 Kapitalabruf');return paid};
const dealOffers=s=>{const f=chosenFund(s);if(!f)return[];const pool=DEALS.filter(d=>!f.holdings.some(h=>h.dealId===d.id)&&(f.strategy==='Diversifiziert'||d.asset===f.strategy));const index=(s.month*7+s.usedReviews*11+s.funds.length*3)%pool.length;return[...pool.slice(index),...pool.slice(0,index)].slice(0,RESEARCH_CAP[s.research]);};
const dueDiligence=(s,id)=>{if(s.usedDD>=Math.max(1,Math.floor(RESEARCH_CAP[s.research]/2)))throw Error('Research-Kapazität ist erschöpft.');if(!dealOffers(s).some(x=>x.id===id))throw Error('Fondsangebot nicht verfügbar.');s.usedDD++;const d=DEALS.find(x=>x.id===id);return d.concentration>58?'Research: Starkes Konzentrationsrisiko in wenigen Portfoliounternehmen.':d.leverage>62?'Research: Hohe Kredithebel und Refinanzierungsrisiken.':d.risk>=5?'Research: Bewertungs-/Exit-Risiken bei schwacher Konjunktur.':'Research: Keine auffälligen Klumpenrisiken im Datenraum.'};
const invest=(s,id,share=.22)=>{
 const f=chosenFund(s),d=DEALS.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!f||!d||!dealOffers(s).some(x=>x.id===id)||!availableReviews(s))throw Error('Deal oder Research-Kapazität nicht verfügbar.');if(!f.commitmentTotal)throw Error('Erst LPs gewinnen.');if(f.age>=f.years*12-18)throw Error('Investitionsphase beendet.');
 if(!(share>0&&share<=.5))throw Error('Unzulässige Commitmentquote.');const open=round(f.commitmentTotal*.70-f.holdings.filter(h=>!h.exited).reduce((a,h)=>a+h.commitment,0)),ticket=round(Math.min(d.max,f.commitmentTotal*share,open));if(ticket<d.min)throw Error('Zu wenig freies Commitment.');const first=round(ticket*.2);if(f.cash+lpOpen(f)<first)throw Error('Erster Abruf nicht finanzierbar.');if(f.cash<first)callCapital(s,f,first-f.cash+Math.min(15000,first*.12));if(f.cash<first)throw Error('Kapital nicht abgerufen.');f.cash=round(f.cash-first);
 const schedule=[.2,.25,.3,.25].map((p,i)=>({month:s.month+[0,4,10,18][i],amount:round(ticket*p),paid:i===0}));schedule[3].amount=round(ticket-schedule.slice(0,3).reduce((a,t)=>a+t.amount,0));const h={dealId:id,name:d.name,asset:d.asset,region:d.region,sector:d.sector,quality:d.quality,risk:d.risk,leverage:d.leverage,concentration:d.concentration,image:d.image,commitment:ticket,paid:first,nav:first,exited:false,age:0,term:d.term,proceeds:0,schedule,history:[{month:s.month,nav:first,index:100}],index:100};f.holdings.push(h);s.usedReviews++;post(s,'Commitment unterschrieben!',`${d.name}: ${currency(ticket)} zugesagt, heute erst ${currency(first)} eingezahlt.`, 'v9_deck','📝 Erste Tranche');return h;
};
const reject=(s,id)=>{if(!availableReviews(s)||!dealOffers(s).some(x=>x.id===id))throw Error('Deal nicht verfügbar.');s.usedReviews++;post(s,'Fonds abgelehnt','Dieser GP nennt es „Investmentphilosophie“. Mort nennt es „Nein“.','v9_iced','❌ Abgelehnt');return true};
const upgrade=(s,type)=>{if(!['sales','research'].includes(type))throw Error('Team unbekannt.');const next=s[type]+1;if(next>4)throw Error('Team voll ausgebaut.');const cost=(type==='sales'?SALES_UP:RESEARCH_UP)[next];if(s.gpCash<cost)throw Error('Nicht genug GP-Kasse.');s.gpCash=round(s.gpCash-cost);s[type]=next;post(s,'Team wächst!',`Level ${next+1} – mehr Möglichkeiten, aber auch mehr Gehälter.`,type==='sales'?'v9_roadshow':'v9_math',`−${currency(cost)}`,true);return next};
const distributeMax=f=>round(Math.max(0,Math.min(f.cash-Math.max(0,targetOpen(f)*.3)-Math.max(0,f.feeDue),f.realized-f.distributions-f.carryReceived)));
const distribute=(s,portion=1,f=chosenFund(s))=>{if(![.25,.5,1].includes(portion)||!f)throw Error('Ungültige Ausschüttung.');const amount=round(distributeMax(f)*portion);if(amount<100)throw Error('Kein ausschüttbarer Rückfluss nach Reserve.');const total=f.clients.reduce((a,c)=>a+c.paid,0);let rem=amount;const clients=f.clients.filter(c=>c.paid>0);for(const [i,c] of clients.entries()){const piece=i===clients.length-1?rem:round(amount*c.paid/total);c.dist=round(c.dist+piece);c.trust=clamp(c.trust+Math.min(3,piece/Math.max(1,c.paid)*12),0,100);rem=round(rem-piece)}f.cash=round(f.cash-amount);f.distributions=round(f.distributions+amount);post(s,'Erste DPI-Rakete!',`${currency(amount)} an LPs ausgeschüttet. Cash statt PowerPoint-Magie!`,'v9_exit',`DPI ${dpi(f).toFixed(2)}x`,true);return amount};
const dpi=f=>f.paidTotal?round(f.distributions/f.paidTotal):0;
const rvpi=f=>f.paidTotal?round(nav(f)/f.paidTotal):0;
const tvpi=f=>round(dpi(f)+rvpi(f));
const allocation=(f,key)=>{const r={};for(const h of f.holdings.filter(h=>!h.exited))r[h[key]]=(r[h[key]]||0)+h.nav;const total=Object.values(r).reduce((a,n)=>a+n,0);return Object.entries(r).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([name,value])=>({name,percent:total?value/total*100:0,value}))};

function nextMonth(s){
 if(s.win||s.loss)throw Error('Das Spiel ist beendet.');s.month++;s.usedTalks=0;s.usedReviews=0;s.usedDD=0;
 s.macros.rates=round(clamp(s.macros.rates+(3.5-s.macros.rates)*.06+noise(s)*.22,1.2,6.6));s.macros.eu=round(clamp(s.macros.eu+(.3-s.macros.eu)*.11+noise(s)*.43,-2.5,2.5));s.macros.us=round(clamp(s.macros.us+(.5-s.macros.us)*.12+noise(s)*.43,-2.5,2.7));
 let fees=0,carry=0,missed=0;
 for(const f of s.funds){if(f.status==='liquidated')continue;f.age++;
  if(f.fundraise&&f.age>=18){if(f.commitmentTotal>=Math.min(1200000,f.target*.24))finalClose(s,f);else{f.fundraise=false;f.status='failed';post(s,'Fundraising gescheitert',`${f.name} hat die Mindestgröße verfehlt. Die Roadshow wird sehr klein.`, 'v9_default','❌ Fundraising',true)}}
  const priceBefore=f.units?nav(f)/f.units:1;
  for(const h of f.holdings.filter(h=>!h.exited)){
   h.age++;const region=h.region==='USA'?s.macros.us:s.macros.eu;const base=.0028+(h.quality-3)*.0026-(h.risk-2)*.0010,rate=(s.macros.rates-3.5)*(h.asset==='Private Real Estate'?.0034:h.asset==='Private Equity'?.0031:.0011),r=clamp(base+region*.0023-rate+noise(s)*h.risk*.006,-.15,.14);
   h.nav=round(Math.max(0,h.nav*(1+r)));h.index=round(h.index*(1+r));
   for(const t of h.schedule.filter(t=>!t.paid&&t.month<=s.month)){
    if(f.cash<t.amount&&lpOpen(f)>0)callCapital(s,f,t.amount-f.cash+Math.min(15000,t.amount*.1));
    if(f.cash+.01>=t.amount){f.cash=round(f.cash-t.amount);h.paid=round(h.paid+t.amount);h.nav=round(h.nav+t.amount);t.paid=true}
    else {missed++;f.missed++;for(const c of f.clients)c.trust=clamp(c.trust-2,0,100)}
   }
   if(h.age>=h.term||f.age>=f.years*12){const amount=h.nav;h.exited=true;h.proceeds=amount;f.realized=round(f.realized+amount);f.realizedProfit=round(f.realizedProfit+amount-h.paid);f.cash=round(f.cash+amount);post(s,'Zielfonds-Exit!',`${h.name} zahlt ${currency(amount)} an deinen Dachfonds zurück.`,h.image,'🥂 Exit',true)}
   h.history.push({month:s.month,nav:h.nav,index:h.index});if(h.history.length>250)h.history.shift();
  }
  const assessment=f.clients.length&&f.status!=='failed'?round(f.commitmentTotal*f.management/12):0;f.feeDue=round(f.feeDue+assessment);
  if(f.cash<f.feeDue&&lpOpen(f)>0)callCapital(s,f,f.feeDue-f.cash+Math.min(12000,assessment));
  const paid=round(Math.min(f.cash,Math.max(0,f.feeDue)));f.cash=round(f.cash-paid);f.feeDue=round(f.feeDue-paid);f.feesReceived=round(f.feesReceived+paid);fees+=paid;
  const required=f.paidTotal*(1+.08*f.age/12);const base=Math.max(0,f.realized-f.distributions-required),due=round(Math.max(0,base*f.carry-f.carryReceived)),taken=round(Math.min(f.cash,due));if(taken>0){f.cash=round(f.cash-taken);f.carryReceived=round(f.carryReceived+taken);carry+=taken;post(s,'Carried Interest!',`${currency(taken)} nach realisiertem Ergebnis und vereinfachter 8-%-Hurdle.`, 'v9_carry',`+${currency(taken)}`,true)}
  const priceAfter=f.units?nav(f)/f.units:1;const ret=f.units?clamp(priceAfter/Math.max(.02,priceBefore)-1,-.4,.4):0;f.recentReturn=round(ret*100);
  for(const c of f.clients){const expected=.0009+Math.max(0,f.management-.0125)*.28;const delta=clamp((ret-expected)*42,-1.8,2.1)-(c.promised?.26:0);c.trust=round(clamp(c.trust+delta-.08,0,100))}f.trust=trust(f);
  if(f.age>=f.years*12&&f.holdings.every(x=>x.exited)&&f.clients.length){const amount=Math.max(0,f.cash-f.feeDue);if(amount>0){const total=f.clients.reduce((a,c)=>a+c.paid,0);for(const c of f.clients){const value=round(amount*c.paid/Math.max(1,total));c.dist=round(c.dist+value)}f.distributions=round(f.distributions+amount);f.cash=round(f.cash-amount)}f.status='liquidated';f.fundraise=false;post(s,'Fonds vollständig liquidiert',`${f.name}: DPI ${dpi(f).toFixed(2)}x. Excel darf endlich schlafen.`,'v9_final','🏁 Abwicklung',true)}
  f.history.push({month:s.month,nav:nav(f),paid:f.paidTotal,dist:f.distributions,dpi:dpi(f),rvpi:rvpi(f),tvpi:tvpi(f),unit:f.units?nav(f)/f.units:1});if(f.history.length>300)f.history.shift();
 }
 const cost=overhead(s);s.gpCash=round(s.gpCash+fees+carry-cost);s.lastIncome={fees:round(fees),carry:round(carry),cost};
 if(s.month%2===0){const recent=s.news.slice(0,7).map(n=>n.title),eligible=COMEDY.filter(i=>!recent.includes(i[0])),n=eligible[Math.floor(rand(s)*eligible.length)];s.gpCash=round(s.gpCash+n[3]);s.macros.eu=round(clamp(s.macros.eu+n[4]*5,-2.5,2.5));post(s,n[0],n[1],n[2],n[3]?`GP: ${currency(n[3])}`:'📰 Branchennews')}
 if(missed)post(s,'Kapitalabruf-Chaos!',`${missed} Zielfonds-Tranchen nicht vollständig bedient. Die LPs runzeln die Stirn.`, 'v9_risk',`⚠️ ${missed} Abrufe`,true);
 s.underwater=s.month>=24&&overallTrust(s)<36&&s.funds.some(f=>f.clients.length)?s.underwater+1:0;
 if(s.underwater>=4){s.loss=true;post(s,'Mandat verloren!',`Vier Monate lang unzufriedene LPs. „Wir sprechen nächste Woche“ war wohl eine Kündigung.`, 'v9_default','😡 LP-Krise',true)}
 if(s.gpCash<0){s.loss=true;post(s,'GP insolvent!',`Mort sucht Arbeit als Senior Excel Survivor.`, 'v9_default','💥 Insolvenz',true)}
 const paidAll=s.funds.reduce((a,f)=>a+f.paidTotal,0),valueAll=s.funds.reduce((a,f)=>a+f.distributions+nav(f),0),netMultiple=paidAll?valueAll/paidAll:0;
 if(!s.loss&&s.funds.length>=2&&wealth(s)>=GOAL&&overallTrust(s)>=64&&netMultiple>=1.12&&s.funds.some(f=>dpi(f)>=.35)){s.win=true;post(s,'PRIVATE MARKETS TYCOON!',`Dein persönliches GP-Vermögen hat ${currency(wealth(s))} erreicht.`, 'v9_final','🏆 Sieg',true)}
 s.history.push({month:s.month,wealth:wealth(s),gpCash:s.gpCash,nav:navAll(s),trust:overallTrust(s)});return{month:s.month,fees,carry,cost,missed};
}
const validate=s=>{if(!s||s.version!==10||!Array.isArray(s.funds)||!Number.isFinite(s.gpCash)||!Number.isFinite(s.month)||s.month<0||s.month>1000||s.funds.length>8||![0,1,2,3,4].includes(s.sales)||![0,1,2,3,4].includes(s.research))throw Error('Ungültiger V10-Spielstand.');for(const f of s.funds){if(!Array.isArray(f.clients)||!Array.isArray(f.holdings)||!Number.isFinite(f.cash)||f.cash<-.01||f.paidTotal<0||f.distributions<0||f.clients.some(c=>c.open<-.01||c.paid<0)||f.holdings.some(h=>h.paid>h.commitment+.01||h.nav<0))throw Error('Ungültige Fondsbuchhaltung.')}return structuredClone(s)};

// app.mjs

const STORAGE='odin-private-markets-v11';
const $=(id)=>document.getElementById(id);
const esc=x=>String(x??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
let focus='pitch',reactionTimer=null,storageUnavailable=false,state,tab='play',currentInterview=null,currentModal='',openDeal=null,lastNotice=0,toastTimer=null,selectedShare=.22,showAllDeals=false,custom=false,launchMode=false;
try{state=validate(JSON.parse((localStorage.getItem(STORAGE)||localStorage.getItem('odin-private-markets-v10'))))}catch(e){state=newGame()}
const image=(id)=>{const key=(id||'v9_fof').replace(/\.webp$/,'');return typeof STORY_ART!=='undefined' && STORY_ART[key] ? STORY_ART[key] : `assets/story/${key}.webp`};
const img=(key,cls='art',alt='Illustration')=>`<img class="${cls}" src="${esc(image(key))}" alt="${esc(alt)}" loading="lazy">`;
const dec=n=>Number(n||0).toLocaleString('de-DE',{maximumFractionDigits:1});
const fmtPct=n=>`${dec(n)} %`;
const cap=(s)=>String(s||'').replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase());
const isPlaying=()=>Boolean(state.funds.length)&&!state.win&&!state.loss;
const date=()=>`${2027+Math.floor(state.month/12)} · M${state.month%12+1}`;
function toast(message){const t=$('toast');t.textContent=message;t.classList.add('on');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('on'),3300)}
function reaction(title,body,pic='v11_scene_01'){
 $('toast').classList.remove('on');const box=$('reaction');clearTimeout(reactionTimer);
 box.innerHTML=`<div class="reaction-art">${img(pic,'reaction-img',title)}</div><div class="reaction-copy"><b>${esc(title)}</b><small>${esc(body)}</small></div><button data-do="hide-reaction" aria-label="Meldung schließen">×</button>`;
 box.classList.add('visible');reactionTimer=setTimeout(()=>box.classList.remove('visible'),4400)
}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE,JSON.stringify(state));storageUnavailable=false}catch(e){storageUnavailable=true}}
function mutate(fn){if(currentModal==='interview')return;const previous=structuredClone(state);try{const before=state.sequence;const result=fn();save();currentInterview=null;openDeal=null;showAllDeals=false;render();if(state.sequence>before){const e=state.lastEvent;if(e?.important)eventModal(e);else if(e)toast(e.title+' · '+(e.effect||e.text))}return result}catch(e){state=previous;render();toast('⚠️ '+e.message);return null}}
function navTab(next){$('reaction').classList.remove('visible');$('toast').classList.remove('on');if(currentModal==='interview'||currentModal==='important')return;if(next!=='play')launchMode=false;tab=next;render();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'})}
function updateHud(){const f=chosenFund(state);$('date').textContent=date();$('rank').textContent=state.win?'🏆 TYCOON':state.loss?'💥 GAME OVER':state.funds.length>1?'FONDS-IMPERIUM':state.funds.length?'FONDSMANAGER':'FONDSGRÜNDER';$('selectedName').textContent=f?.name||'Mort Capital';$('wealth').textContent=currency(wealth(state));$('nav').textContent=currency(navAll(state));$('aum').textContent=currency(state.funds.reduce((a,f)=>a+f.commitmentTotal,0));$('gp').textContent=currency(state.gpCash);$('trust').textContent=dec(overallTrust(state))+'/100';$('progress').style.width=Math.min(100,wealth(state)/GOAL*100)+'%';$('macro').innerHTML=[['🏦 Zinsen',state.macros.rates,'%'],['🇪🇺 Europa',state.macros.eu,''],['🇺🇸 USA',state.macros.us,'']].map(([k,v,u])=>`<div><small>${k}</small><b>${v>0&&u!== '%' ? '+':''}${dec(v)}${u}</b></div>`).join('');$('ticker').innerHTML=`📰 NEWSBOARD <span>${esc(state.news[0]?.title||'Mort Capital startet.')}</span>`;$('fee').textContent=`💼 Letzter Monat: Fee ${currency(state.lastIncome.fees)} + Carry ${currency(state.lastIncome.carry)} − Kosten ${currency(state.lastIncome.cost)} = ${currency(state.lastIncome.fees+state.lastIncome.carry-state.lastIncome.cost)}`;document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.tab===tab))}
function metric(label,value){return `<div class="metric"><small>${label}</small><b>${value}</b></div>`}
function section(title,body,extra=''){return `<section class="card ${extra}"><div class="pad"><h2>${title}</h2>${body}</div></section>`}
function actions(body){return `<div class="actions">${body}</div>`}
function b(action,text,cl='gold',extra=''){return `<button class="btn ${cl}" data-do="${action}" ${extra}>${text}</button>`}
function offerCard(d,compact=false){
 if(!d)return section('Der Dealflow ist leer','<p>Das Research-Team hat für diesen Monat alle Angebote durchgesehen.</p>');
 const f=chosenFund(state),open=f?round(f.commitmentTotal*.70-f.holdings.filter(h=>!h.exited).reduce((a,h)=>a+h.commitment,0)):0;
 const ticket=share=>f?round(Math.max(0,Math.min(d.max,f.commitmentTotal*share,open))):0;
 const money=ticket(selectedShare),ready=money>=d.min&&availableReviews(state)>0&&f.commitmentTotal>0;
 const candidates=[.22,.35,.5].map(x=>{const t=ticket(x),enough=t>=d.min;
 return `<button data-do="set-share" data-share="${x}" class="${Math.abs(selectedShare-x)<.0001?'chosen':''}" aria-pressed="${Math.abs(selectedShare-x)<.0001}" title="${enough?'Ausreichend':'Unter Mindestticket'}"><span>${Math.round(x*100)} %</span><small>${currency(t)}</small></button>`}).join('');
 const alert=!f.commitmentTotal?'Überzeuge zuerst einen Investor.':ready?'Das Ticket deckt die Mindestinvestition.':`Mindestticket ${currency(d.min)}. Wähle eine höhere Quote oder gewinne weitere LPs.`;
 let metrics=d.metrics.slice(0,3).map(([k,v])=>metric(esc(k),esc(v))).join('');
 return `<article class="card"><div class="pad"><div class="eyebrow">ZIELFONDS · ${esc(d.asset)} · ${esc(d.region)}</div><h2>${esc(d.name)}</h2>${img(d.image,'deal-image',d.name)}<p>${esc(d.description||'Der GP präsentiert sein nächstes Kapitalversprechen.')}</p><div class="metrics">${metrics}</div><p class="tiny muted">Historische Werte, keine Renditegarantie · ${esc(d.sector)} · Vintage ${d.vintage}</p><div class="ticket-panel"><strong>🎟️ Deine Investmentquote</strong><div class="ticket-options" role="group" aria-label="Anteil des LP-Commitments für dieses Investment">${candidates}</div><small class="ticket-hint ${ready?'ready':''}">${esc(alert)}</small></div>${actions(`${b('invest','✍️ '+(ready?'Investieren · '+currency(money):'Noch nicht finanzierbar'),'green',`data-id="${d.id}" ${ready?'':'disabled'}`)}${b('reject','✕ Ablehnen','danger',`data-id="${d.id}"`)}<details class="optional-dd"><summary>Recherche ansehen</summary>${b('dd','Research-Check starten','ghost',`data-id="${d.id}"`)}</details>`)}</div></article>`;
}
function fundChoice(f){return `<button class="fund-choice ${state.selected===f.id?'active':''}" data-do="choose-fund" data-id="${f.id}"><b>🏛 ${esc(f.name)}</b><small>${esc(f.strategy)} · Vintage ${f.vintage} · NAV ${currency(nav(f))} · DPI ${dec(dpi(f))}x ${f.status==='liquidated'?'· abgewickelt':''}</small></button>`}
function setupView(){const form=custom?`<div class="form-grid"><label>Strategie<select id="strategy">${FUND_STYLES.map(x=>`<option>${esc(x)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Zielvolumen<select id="target"><option value="6000000">6 Mio. €</option><option value="12000000">12 Mio. €</option><option value="25000000">25 Mio. €</option></select></label><label>Laufzeit<select id="years">${[5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12].map(x=>`<option value="${x}" ${x===8?'selected':''}>${x} Jahre</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Management Fee<select id="management"><option value="0.01">1,0 % p.a.</option><option value="0.015" selected>1,5 % p.a.</option><option value="0.02">2,0 % p.a.</option><option value="0.025">2,5 % p.a.</option></select></label><label>Carry<select id="carry"><option value="0.1">10 %</option><option value="0.15" selected>15 %</option><option value="0.2">20 %</option><option value="0.25">25 %</option></select></label></div>`:'';return `<div class="v11-launch"><div class="launch-image">${img('mort_original','art','Mort, dein Fondsgründer')}<details class="premium-gallery"><summary>V11 Titelillustration</summary>${img('v11_cover','art','Premium Edition Titelillustration')}</details></div><div class="launch-content"><div class="eyebrow">${launchMode?'DEINE NÄCHSTE FONDSGENERATION':'DEIN IMPERIUM BEGINNT'}</div><h1>${launchMode?'Noch einen Fonds auflegen?':'Eine gute Idee. Ein teurer Anzug. Null Anleger.'}</h1><p>Gründe deinen Fonds, überzeug Investoren und verwandle echte Exits in Gebühren, Ausschüttungen und Reputation.</p>${form}<div class="actions">${b('start-fund',custom?'Fonds mit diesen Konditionen gründen':'Jetzt Fonds gründen','gold')}${b('custom',custom?'Weniger Optionen':'Konditionen anpassen','ghost')}</div><div class="tiny muted">Standard: diversifiziert · 6 Mio. € Ziel · 8 Jahre · 1,5 % Fee · 15 % Carry</div></div></div>`}

function newFundView(){if(state.funds.length>=8)return section('Fondsimperium ausgebaut','<p>Mehr als acht eigene Fonds lassen sich in dieser Partie nicht gleichzeitig auflegen.</p>');return `<div class="intro"><div class="eyebrow">NÄCHSTE GENERATION</div><h1>Neuen Dachfonds auflegen</h1><p>Ein guter Track Record macht das Fundraising leichter. Ein schlechter wird zum sehr teuren Gesprächseinstieg.</p></div>${setupView().replace('Dein erster Fonds','Noch eine Fondsgeneration')}`}

const ODIN_DISTRICTS=[
 {asset:'Private Equity',label:'Unternehmen',parts:'<rect class="base" x="21" y="26" width="68" height="45" rx="3"/><rect class="roof" x="15" y="22" width="80" height="7" rx="2"/><rect class="face" x="33" y="4" width="44" height="21" rx="2"/><path class="shadow" d="M51 4h10v18H51z"/><rect class="lit" x="29" y="37" width="11" height="9"/><rect class="lit" x="48" y="37" width="11" height="9"/><rect class="lit" x="68" y="37" width="11" height="9"/><rect class="lit" x="48" y="54" width="13" height="16"/>'},
 {asset:'Private Debt',label:'Kredite',parts:'<rect class="base" x="18" y="30" width="75" height="43" rx="2"/><path class="roof" d="M10 31 55 7l46 24z"/><rect class="face" x="29" y="32" width="9" height="33"/><rect class="face" x="49" y="32" width="9" height="33"/><rect class="face" x="69" y="32" width="9" height="33"/><rect class="lit" x="44" y="13" width="22" height="6" rx="2"/><rect class="roof" x="12" y="67" width="87" height="7"/>'},
 {asset:'Infrastructure',label:'Infrastruktur',parts:'<rect class="base" x="11" y="59" width="88" height="13" rx="2"/><rect class="face" x="19" y="42" width="55" height="18"/><path class="roof" d="M13 43 49 29l32 14z"/><rect class="lit" x="25" y="47" width="9" height="9"/><rect class="lit" x="44" y="47" width="9" height="9"/><path class="roof" d="M90 7v58" stroke="#d8c298" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M90 24 58 37M90 24l30 13M90 24V-5" stroke="#e5d3a4" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>'},
 {asset:'Private Real Estate',label:'Immobilien',parts:'<rect class="base" x="20" y="12" width="30" height="59"/><rect class="face" x="55" y="28" width="35" height="43"/><path class="roof" d="M16 12 35 2l19 10z"/><rect class="lit" x="28" y="22" width="10" height="9"/><rect class="lit" x="28" y="40" width="10" height="9"/><rect class="lit" x="63" y="39" width="9" height="10"/><rect class="lit" x="76" y="39" width="8" height="10"/><rect class="roof" x="11" y="70" width="87" height="4"/>'}
];
function odinWorld(){
 const holds=state.funds.flatMap(f=>f.holdings).filter(h=>!h.exited),closed=state.funds.flatMap(f=>f.holdings).filter(h=>h.exited);
 const momentum=(state.macros.eu+state.macros.us)/2;
 const market=state.macros.rates>5.2?'🔒 Teure Finanzierung':momentum>1?'🚀 Boomphase':momentum<-.6?'🌧️ Abschwung':'🌤️ Stabiles Marktumfeld';
 const plots=ODIN_DISTRICTS.map(d=>{const n=holds.filter(h=>h.asset===d.asset).length,exits=closed.filter(h=>h.asset===d.asset).length;
 return `<div class="world-plot ${n?'filled':''}" aria-label="${esc(d.asset)}: ${n} aktive Investments, ${exits} Exits"><div class="world-art"><svg viewBox="0 0 110 78" aria-hidden="true">${d.parts}</svg></div><b>${esc(d.label)}</b><small>${n?n+' aktiv':exits?exits+' verkauft':'Noch frei'}</small></div>`;}).join('');
 const all=holds.length;
 return `<section class="odin-world" aria-label="Dein wachsendes Investmentimperium"><div class="world-heading"><div><h2>🏙️ Dein Investmentimperium</h2><p>${all?'Aus '+all+' aktiven Investments wächst dein Stadtviertel.':'Deine Investitionen erwecken dieses Viertel zum Leben.'}</p></div><span class="market-badge">${market}</span></div><div class="world-grid">${plots}</div></section>`;
}
function odinMission(){
 const holdings=state.funds.reduce((a,f)=>a+f.holdings.length,0),commit=state.funds.some(f=>f.commitmentTotal>0),steps=1+Number(commit)+Number(commit&&holdings>0)+Number(commit&&holdings>0&&state.month>=3);
 const descriptions=['Gründe deinen ersten Fonds.','Überzeuge deinen ersten Investor.','Beteilige dich an einem Zielfonds.','Spiele bis zum vierten Monat.','Mission geschafft! Dein Imperium ist gestartet.'];
 return `<aside class="mission-board" aria-label="Einstiegsmission: ${steps} von 4 Schritten"><div class="mission-main"><b>⚔️ Mission: Vom Anzug zum Imperium</b><small>${descriptions[Math.min(4,steps)]}</small><div class="mission-track"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,steps/4*100)}%"></i></div></div><span class="mission-level">${steps}/4</span></aside>`;
}
function playView(){if(!state.funds.length||launchMode)return setupView();if(state.win||state.loss)return endView();const f=chosenFund(state),offers=dealOffers(state),talks=availableTalks(state),reviews=availableReviews(state);if(!f.fundraise&&focus==='pitch')focus='deal';if(f.fundraise&&talks&&!reviews)focus='pitch';if(!talks&&reviews)focus='deal';const pitchCard=`<article class="card feature-card"><div class="feature-visual">${img('v11_interview_02','art','Mort im Investorengespräch')}</div><div class="pad"><div class="eyebrow">FUNDRAISING · ${esc(f.name)}</div><h2>Wer unterschreibt heute?</h2><p>Ein Gespräch, drei Antworten. Und hoffentlich eine Unterschrift, die mehr wert ist als dein Anzug.</p><div class="feature-facts"><span>🤝 ${talks} Gespräche frei</span><span>💼 ${currency(f.commitmentTotal)} zugesagt</span></div>${actions(b('talk','Investor kennenlernen','gold',talks&&f.fundraise?'':'disabled')+(f.firstClose?b('final-close','Final Closing','ghost') :''))}</div></article>`;const dealCard=reviews?offerCard(offers[0]):section('Research macht Feierabend','<p>Alle Fondsangebote für diesen Monat sind geprüft. Dein Analyst möchte sein Wochenende zurück.</p>');const canFollowOn=state.funds.length<8&&!state.funds.some(x=>x.fundraise&&!x.finalClose)&&state.month-state.funds.at(-1).launchMonth>=12;return `<div class="decision-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">${date()} · ${esc(f.name)}</div><h1>Deine nächste Entscheidung</h1><p>Ein gutes Urteil. Ein großer Fonds. Oder eine ziemlich teure Pointe.</p></div><button class="month-inline" data-do="next-month">Nächster Monat <b>→</b></button></div>${canFollowOn?`<div class="follow-on-prompt"><span>✨ <b>Neue Fondsgeneration möglich</b><small>Dein Track Record wirkt beim nächsten Fundraising.</small></span>${b('new-fund','Neuen Fonds auflegen','gold')}</div>`:''}${odinMission()}<div class="choice-tabs"><button data-do="focus-pitch" class="${focus==='pitch'?'chosen':''}" ${!f.fundraise?'disabled':''}>🤝 Anleger <span>${talks}</span></button><button data-do="focus-deal" class="${focus==='deal'?'chosen':''}">🎯 Zielfonds <span>${reviews}</span></button></div><div class="focus-content">${focus==='pitch'&&f.fundraise?pitchCard:dealCard}</div>${odinWorld()}<div class="subtle-foot"><span>🏛 ${currency(nav(f))} Fonds-NAV</span><span>💶 ${currency(f.cash)} Fondskasse</span>${b('go-funds','Fondsdetails','ghost')}</div>`}

function chart(history,key='nav',color='#f2c66c'){const arr=(history||[]).filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x[key]));if(arr.length<2)return `<div class="summary tiny">Die Kurve entsteht mit den ersten Spielmonaten.</div>`;const vals=arr.map(x=>x[key]),min=Math.min(...vals,0),max=Math.max(...vals,1),lo=min===max?min-1:min,hi=max===lo?lo+1:max,pts=arr.map((x,i)=>`${30+i*600/(arr.length-1)},${170-(x[key]-lo)/(hi-lo)*145}`).join(' ');return `<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 650 190" role="img" aria-label="Historische ${esc(key)}-Entwicklung"><rect width="650" height="190" rx="12" fill="#0a2033"/><g stroke="#274459" stroke-width="1">${[30,70,110,150].map(y=>`<path d="M30 ${y} H635"/>`).join('')}</g><polyline fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" points="${pts}"/><text x="35" y="20" fill="#d5e4e9" font-size="13">${currency(vals.at(-1))}</text><text x="35" y="182" fill="#aac2d0" font-size="11">Start</text><text x="610" y="182" text-anchor="end" fill="#aac2d0" font-size="11">Heute</text></svg>`}
function bars(data){if(!data.length)return '<p class="muted tiny">Noch keine eingezahlten Zielfondsinvestments.</p>';return `<div class="bars">${data.map(x=>`<div class="bar"><span>${esc(x.name)}</span><span class="bar-track"><i style="width:${x.percent.toFixed(2)}%"></i></span><b>${dec(x.percent)} %</b></div>`).join('')}</div>`}
function fundsView(){const f=chosenFund(state);if(!f)return setupView();const canNew=state.funds.length<8&&(!state.funds.some(x=>x.fundraise&&!x.finalClose))&&state.month-state.funds.at(-1).launchMonth>=12;return `<div class="page-title"><div class="eyebrow">DEINE FONDSGESELLSCHAFT</div><h1>Meine Fonds</h1><p>Jeder Dachfonds hat eigene Anleger, Commitments und Ausschüttungen.</p></div><div class="stack fund-grid">${state.funds.map(fundChoice).join('')}</div><div class="section">${section('📈 '+esc(f.name),`<div class="metrics">${metric('Fonds-NAV',currency(nav(f)))}${metric('DPI',dec(dpi(f))+'x')}${metric('TVPI',dec(tvpi(f))+'x')}</div>${chart(f.history)}<details class="fund-ledger"><summary>Kapital und Commitments anzeigen</summary><div class="stat-line"><span>Paid-in der LPs</span><b>${currency(f.paidTotal)}</b></div><div class="stat-line"><span>Ausgeschüttet an LPs</span><b>${currency(f.distributions)}</b></div><div class="stat-line"><span>RVPI</span><b>${dec(rvpi(f))}x</b></div><div class="stat-line"><span>Offene LP-Commitments</span><b>${currency(lpOpen(f))}</b></div><div class="stat-line"><span>Noch ausstehende Zielfondsabrufe</span><b>${currency(targetOpen(f))}</b></div><div class="stat-line"><span>LP-Zufriedenheit</span><b>${dec(trust(f))}/100</b></div><div class="stat-line"><span>Fundraising</span><b>${f.finalClose?'Final Closing':f.fundraise?'Offen':esc(f.status)}</b></div></details>${actions(`${b('call-lp','💶 25 % LP-Kapital abrufen','ghost',lpOpen(f)>0?'':'disabled')}${b('show-distribute','💸 Ausschütten','green',distributeMax(f)>99?'':'disabled')}`)}<details><summary>🌍 Länder- und Sektorallokation</summary><h3>Länder</h3>${bars(allocation(f,'region'))}<h3>Sektoren</h3>${bars(allocation(f,'sector'))}</details><details><summary>📑 Zielfonds und Einzel-NAVs (${f.holdings.length})</summary>${f.holdings.length?f.holdings.map(h=>`<div class="holding"><b>${esc(h.name)}</b><small>${esc(h.asset)} · ${esc(h.region)} · ${esc(h.sector)}</small><div class="stat-line"><span>Commitment / eingezahlt</span><b>${currency(h.commitment)} / ${currency(h.paid)}</b></div><div class="stat-line"><span>Aktueller NAV / Abrufe offen</span><b>${currency(h.exited?0:h.nav)} / ${currency(h.exited?0:Math.max(0,h.commitment-h.paid))}</b></div>${chart(h.history)}</div>`).join(''):'<p>Keine Zielfondspositionen.</p>'}</details>`)}</div><div class="section">${section('🚀 Fondsimperium ausbauen',`<p>Neue Fondsgenerationen erleichtern mit gutem Track Record die Anlegerakquise, erhöhen aber deine Fixkosten.</p>${actions(`${b('new-fund','Neuen Fonds auflegen','gold',canNew?'':'disabled')}`)}${!canNew?'<p class="tiny muted">Vorher Final Closing durchführen und mindestens zwölf Monate seit der letzten Auflage warten.</p>':''}`)}</div>`}
function teamView(){return `<div class="page-title"><div class="eyebrow">DEIN TEAM</div><h1>Forschung & Vertrieb</h1><p>Mehr Kapazität kostet Gehalt. Ohne gute Fonds wird selbst das beste Sales-Team nicht zum Wunder.</p></div><div class="two">${['research','sales'].map(type=>{const isR=type==='research',lvl=state[type],cfg=isR?RESEARCH:SALES;return section(isR?'🔍 Research':'📣 Sales',`${img(isR?'v9_math':'v9_roadshow','wide-art',isR?'Research-Team':'Sales-Team')}<div class="metrics">${metric('Team-Level',(lvl+1)+' / 5')}${metric('Kapazität / Monat',cfg.capacity[lvl])}${metric('Gehalt / Monat',currency(cfg.costs[lvl]))}</div><p>${isR?'Analysiere mehr Zielfonds und erkenne Konzentrations- und Leverage-Risiken.':'Sprich mehr potenzielle Anleger für deine eigenen Fonds an.'}</p>${actions(`${b('upgrade','⬆ Team ausbauen · '+(lvl<4?currency(cfg.upgrade[lvl+1]):'Max.'),'gold',`data-type="${type}" ${lvl>=4?'disabled':''}`)}`)}`)}).join('')}</div><div class="section">${section('💼 GP-Gewinn- und Verlustrechnung',`<div class="stat-line"><span>Letzte Management Fees</span><b>${currency(state.lastIncome.fees)}</b></div><div class="stat-line"><span>Realisierter Carry</span><b>${currency(state.lastIncome.carry)}</b></div><div class="stat-line"><span>Betriebskosten inkl. Teams</span><b>−${currency(state.lastIncome.cost)}</b></div><div class="stat-line"><span>Monatliches GP-Ergebnis</span><b>${currency(state.lastIncome.fees+state.lastIncome.carry-state.lastIncome.cost)}</b></div>`)}</div>`}
function newsView(){return `<div class="page-title"><div class="eyebrow">BRANCHENFUNK</div><h1>Das Newsboard</h1><p>Mort nennt es Marktintelligenz. Sein CFO nennt es dramatisch.</p></div><div class="event-list">${state.events.slice(0,40).map(e=>`<article>${img(e.pic,'news-img',e.title)}<div><b>Monat ${e.month} · ${esc(e.title)}</b><small>${esc(e.text)}</small><small>${esc(e.effect||'')}</small></div></article>`).join('')||'<p>Das erste Abenteuer wartet.</p>'}</div>`}
function endView(){const win=state.win;return `<div class="hero card">${img(win?'v11_victory':'v9_default','art',win?'Mort feiert seinen Sieg':'Mort erleidet einen Fondskollaps')}<div><div class="eyebrow">${win?'🏆 SIEG':'💥 GAME OVER'}</div><h1>${win?'DAS FONDSIMPERIUM STEHT!':'DU BIST EINE SCHANDE FÜR DEN KAPITALMARKT!'}</h1><p>${win?`Dein persönliches GP-Vermögen: ${currency(wealth(state))}, bei ${state.funds.length} eigenen Fonds.`:'Eine Private-Markets-Karriere lässt sich nicht durch die PowerPoint-Funktion „Rückgängig“ retten.'}</p><p>Monat ${state.month} · ${state.funds.length} Fonds</p>${actions(b('restart','🔁 Noch einmal spielen','gold'))}</div></div>`}
function render(){updateHud();$('screen').innerHTML=tab==='play'?playView():tab==='funds'?fundsView():tab==='team'?teamView():newsView()}
function closeModal(){if(currentModal==='important'||currentModal==='interview'||currentModal==='settings'||currentModal==='distribute'||currentModal==='restart'){}currentModal='';$('overlay').innerHTML='';$('overlay').classList.remove('visible');}
function modalContent(inner){$('overlay').innerHTML=inner;$('overlay').classList.add('visible');}
function eventModal(e){currentModal='important';modalContent(`<div class="modal">${img(e.pic,'art',e.title)}<div class="copy"><div class="eyebrow">${e.important?'COMIC-EVENT':'NEWS'}</div><h2>${esc(e.title)}</h2><div class="speech">${esc(e.text)}</div><p>${esc(e.effect||'')}</p>${actions(b('close-modal','Weiter →','gold'))}</div></div>`)}
function talkModal(){const p=prospect(state);if(!p){toast('Für diesen Fonds sind gerade keine weiteren potenziellen Anleger erreichbar.');return}currentInterview=p;currentModal='interview';modalContent(`<div class="modal">${img(p.image,'art','Gespräch mit '+p.name)}<div class="copy"><div class="eyebrow">INVESTOR-INTERVIEW · ${esc(p.kind)}</div><h2>${esc(p.name)}</h2><div class="speech">${esc(p.question)}</div><div class="choices">${options(p).map((o,i)=>b('answer',String.fromCharCode(65+i)+'. '+esc(o.text),'ghost',`data-answer="${i}"`)).join('')}</div><p class="tiny muted">Antwort beeinflusst das Gespräch und spätere Anlegererwartungen.</p></div></div>`)}
function settingsModal(){currentModal='settings';modalContent(`<div class="modal single"><div class="copy"><h2>⚙️ Spielstand</h2><p>Speichert automatisch lokal, soweit dein Browser dies erlaubt. JSON-Export/-Import ist jederzeit möglich.</p>${storageUnavailable?'<p class="tiny muted">Dieser Browser erlaubt derzeit keine lokale Speicherung. Verwende den JSON-Export.</p>':''}${actions(`${b('export','⬇ Spielstand exportieren','gold')}${b('import','⬆ Spielstand importieren','ghost')}${b('ask-restart','↺ Neues Spiel','danger')}${b('close-modal','Schließen','ghost')}`)}</div></div>`)}
function distModal(){const f=chosenFund(state);currentModal='distribute';modalContent(`<div class="modal">${img('v9_exit','art','Ausschüttung nach Exit')}<div class="copy"><h2>💸 Ausschüttung an LPs</h2><p>Aus echten Zielfonds-Rückflüssen stehen ${currency(distributeMax(f))} zur Verfügung. Reserven für Abrufe sind berücksichtigt.</p>${actions(`${b('distribute','25 % ausschütten','ghost','data-portion="0.25"')}${b('distribute','50 % ausschütten','ghost','data-portion="0.5"')}${b('distribute','100 % ausschütten','gold','data-portion="1"')}`)}${actions(b('close-modal','Schließen','ghost'))}</div></div>`)}
function readSetup(){if(!custom)return{};const num=id=>Number($(id)?.value);return {strategy:$('strategy').value,target:num('target'),years:num('years'),management:num('management'),carry:num('carry')}}
function handleAction(btn){const action=btn.dataset.do,id=btn.dataset.id,portion=Number(btn.dataset.portion||1);if(action==='hide-reaction'){$('reaction').classList.remove('visible');return}if(action==='focus-pitch'){$('reaction').classList.remove('visible');$('toast').classList.remove('on');focus='pitch';render();return}if(action==='focus-deal'){$('reaction').classList.remove('visible');$('toast').classList.remove('on');focus='deal';render();return}if(action==='set-share'){const x=Number(btn.dataset.share);if([.22,.35,.5].includes(x)){selectedShare=x;render()}return}if(action==='close-modal'){closeModal();return}if(action==='settings'){settingsModal();return}if(action==='export'){const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(state,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='MortCapital_V11_3_Spielstand.json';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),5000);toast('JSON-Spielstand exportiert.');return}if(action==='import'){$('savefile').click();return}if(action==='ask-restart'){currentModal='restart';modalContent(`<div class="modal single"><div class="copy"><h2>Wirklich neu starten?</h2><p>Dein bisheriger Spielstand wird überschrieben. Sichere ihn bei Bedarf vorher als JSON.</p>${actions(`${b('restart','Ja, neues Imperium','danger')}${b('close-modal','Abbrechen','ghost')}`)}</div></div>`);return}if(action==='restart'){focus='pitch';state=newGame();custom=false;launchMode=false;tab='play';save();closeModal();render();return}if(action==='custom'){custom=!custom;render();return}if(action==='start-fund'){focus='pitch';const param=readSetup();const f=mutate(()=>startFund(state,param));if(f){custom=false;launchMode=false;render()}return}if(action==='new-fund'){launchMode=true;custom=true;tab='play';render();window.scrollTo(0,0);return}if(action==='choose-fund'){state.selected=id;tab='funds';save();render();return}if(action==='go-funds'){navTab('funds');return}if(action==='next-month'){$('reaction').classList.remove('visible');mutate(()=>nextMonth(state));return}if(action==='talk'){talkModal();return}if(action==='answer'){if(!currentInterview)return;let p=currentInterview,ans=Number(btn.dataset.answer);closeModal();const result=mutate(()=>pitch(state,p.id,ans));if(result)reaction(result.won?'Neues Commitment!':'Investor noch skeptisch',result.won?`${p.name} sagt ${currency(result.value)} zu. Mort bestellt schon eine größere Visitenkarte.`:`${p.name} hat das Pitchdeck mitgenommen. Das zählt leider nicht als Commitment.`,'v11_scene_01');return}if(action==='final-close'){mutate(()=>finalClose(state));return}if(action==='call-lp'){mutate(()=>callLP(state,.25));return}if(action==='invest'){const d=DEALS.find(x=>x.id===id);const r=mutate(()=>invest(state,id,selectedShare));if(r)reaction('Commitment unterschrieben!',(d?.name||'Zielfonds')+' – jetzt müssen die Abrufe sitzen.','v11_scene_05');return}if(action==='reject'){const d=DEALS.find(x=>x.id===id);const r=mutate(()=>reject(state,id));if(r)reaction('Höflich abgelehnt',`Der GP von ${d?.name||'diesem Fonds'} nennt das eine verpasste Jahrhundertchance.`,'v11_scene_03');return}if(action==='dd'){try{toast(dueDiligence(state,id));save()}catch(e){toast(e.message)}return}if(action==='upgrade'){mutate(()=>upgrade(state,btn.dataset.type));return}if(action==='show-distribute'){distModal();return}if(action==='distribute'){closeModal();mutate(()=>distribute(state,portion));return}}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const btn=e.target.closest('[data-do],[data-tab]');if(!btn||btn.disabled)return;if(btn.dataset.tab){navTab(btn.dataset.tab);return}handleAction(btn)});
$('savefile').addEventListener('change',async e=>{const file=e.target.files[0];if(!file)return;try{const candidate=validate(JSON.parse(await file.text()));state=candidate;closeModal();tab='play';save();render();toast('✅ Spielstand wiederhergestellt.')}catch(error){toast('Import verweigert: '+error.message)}finally{e.target.value=''}});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&currentModal&&currentModal!=='interview'&&currentModal!=='important')closeModal()});
if(location.protocol==='about:')window.__odinQA={snapshot:()=>({month:state.month,win:state.win,loss:state.loss,seed:state.seed,gp:state.gpCash,funds:state.funds.map(f=>({id:f.id,fundraise:f.fundraise,firstClose:f.firstClose,commitment:f.commitmentTotal,target:f.target,age:f.age,dist:f.distributions,holds:f.holdings.length,nav:nav(f),dpi:dpi(f)})),selected:state.selected,availableTalks:availableTalks(state),availableReviews:availableReviews(state),offer:dealOffers(state)[0]&&{id:dealOffers(state)[0].id,metrics:dealOffers(state)[0].metrics,asset:dealOffers(state)[0].asset},distributable:chosenFund(state)?distributeMax(chosenFund(state)):0}),answer:()=>{const p=currentInterview;if(!p)return 0;const o=options(p);let k=o.findIndex(x=>x.key===p.style);return k<0?Math.max(0,o.findIndex(x=>x.key==='daten')):k}};
render();
</script></body></html>
